newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch July producer prices rise 1.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch July producer prices rise 1.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Dutch producer price index (PPI) for manufactured goods rose a provisional 0.1 percent in July from June, giving a 1.6 percent rise year-on-year, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
DUTCH PRODUCER PRICES July 96 June 96 July 95
The CBS said the most significant rise in July compared to June was for crude oil, which rose 3.7 percent. Compared to July 1995 the price of crude rose over 20 percent, the CBS said.
Prices in the paper industry slipped just a little month-on-month, but compared to July 1995 paper prices dipped over 10 percent, the CBS said.
